events.title: Chrome for Android released
events.summary: Google released Chrome for Android on June 27, 2012 — bringing the Blink/WebKit engine and Chrome sync to the world's dominant mobile OS.
events.about: Chrome for Android made mobile browsing a first-class Google product: tab sync with desktop, V8 performance, and later dominance on Android phones. It extended the Chrome ecosystem beyond desktops and set the stage for WebView powering in-app browsers.

narrative.whyChosen: Mobile Chrome put Google's browser on the platform that would define the next decade of web usage.
narrative.whyImportant: It made Chrome the default mental model for mobile browsing outside Apple's walled garden.
narrative.problemSolved: Android's stock browser lagged desktop Chrome in speed, sync, and developer tools.
